simulations.lens: Anabaptist / Mennonite (Schleitheim Confession, Confession of Faith in a Mennonite Perspective 1995)
simulations.headline: Firmly synergist, memorialist, covenantal
simulations.comment: Answers as a typical informed Mennonite (CFMP 1995 / Schleitheim): S1 -2, S2 +2, S3 -1 (faith is a gift of grace, but not tied to unconditional election); S4 -1 (Christ present in the gathered body, not the elements), S5 +2, S6 -2; S7 +1, S8 -1, S9 +1 (prophecy weighed by the congregation, 1 Cor 14:29); S10 -1, S11 +1 (one people of God, uneasy with 'true Israel'), S12 -2; S13 -1 (creeds have derived authority only), S14 +2, S15 +1 (the congregation tests interpretation, CFMP Art. 4, but 'the church... final interpreter' reads as magisterium); S16 -1, S17 -1 (Mennonite worship is planned and plain, not 'free-form'), S18 -2 (communion twice a year to monthly). Raw: grace = (-1)(-2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1) = 5 -> round(11/12*100) = 92; table = (-1)(-1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-2) = 5 -> 92; spirit = (-1)(1)+(1)(-1)+(-1)(1) = -3 -> round(3/12*100) = 25; kingdom = (1)(-1)+(-1)(1)+(1)(-2) = -4 -> round(2/12*100) = 17; tradition = (-1)(-1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(1) = 2 -> round(8/12*100) = 67; worship = (-1)(-1)+(1)(-1)+(-1)(-2) = 2 -> 67. Headline: |score-50| = 42, 42, 25, 33, 17, 17; top three by deviation with index tie-break = grace (92, 'firmly synergist'), table (92, 'memorialist'), kingdom (17, 'covenantal'). Distances: Anabaptist (75,85,55,30,70,60): 17^2+7^2+30^2+13^2+3^2+7^2 = 289+49+900+169+9+49 = 1465 -> 38.3 (84% match). Charismatic non-denom (70,80,5,60,85,90): 484+144+400+1849+324+529 = 3730 -> 61.1. Wesleyan (80,40,45,25,45,40): 144+2704+400+64+484+729 = 4525 -> 67.3. Pentecostal 69.4, SBC 88.9, Reformed Baptist 102.7, Anglican 105.7, Presbyterian 116.0, Dispensational 116.7, RC 125.2, EO 126.8, Lutheran 128.0. It lands, and it is robust: a moderate Mennonite (67,92,33,33,58,58) lands at 27.5, and a community-hermeneutic Mennonite who answers S15 = +2 and S13 = 0 (tradition 50) still lands at 43.1. Two things went wrong on the way there: (1) the second-nearest tradition shown on the card and in the share text is 'Charismatic non-denominational', which no Mennonite would accept as a neighbour; no peace church or free church is anywhere near because nothing on the six axes measures the believers'-church / nonresistance / church-and-state question that defines Anabaptism; (2) the headline names me with two other traditions' vocabulary ('synergist' is the Formula of Concord's heresy label, 'covenantal' is the Reformed federal system used to justify infant baptism against us). The largest divergence from the hand-set coordinate is Spirit: I score 25, the coordinate says 55; there is no cessationism in any Anabaptist confession, so 55 is too far right (propose 40).

simulations.lens: Anglican (broad, Thirty-Nine Articles / Book of Common Prayer)
simulations.headline: Sacramental, liturgical, covenantal
simulations.comment: Answers as a typical Prayer-Book Anglican: S1 +1 (Art. XVII predestination to life, read pastorally with Art. XVI), S2 +1 (Art. XVI, Homily of Falling from God), S3 +1 (Art. X, XVII: chosen 'in Christ', faith a gift); S4 +2 (Art. XXVIII, Catechism 'verily and indeed taken and received'), S5 -2 (Art. XXVII: baptism 'as by an instrument' grafts into the Church; infants have made no decision), S6 +2 (Art. XXVII); S7 0 (three gifts bundled plus 'as in Acts'), S8 -1, S9 +1; S10 -1, S11 +1, S12 -2; S13 +2 (Art. VIII), S14 0 (forced: Art. VI says yes, Art. XXXIV says no), S15 0 (Art. XX yes, Art. XXI 'may err'); S16 +2, S17 -2, S18 +1 (post-Parish-Communion norm). Raw and scores: Grace (-1)(1)+(1)(1)+(-1)(1) = -1 -> round(5/12*100) = 42; Table (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2) = -6 -> 0; Spirit 0+(1)(-1)+(-1)(1) = -2 -> 33; Kingdom (1)(-1)+(-1)(1)+(1)(-2) = -4 -> 17; Tradition (-1)(2)+0+0 = -2 -> 33; Worship (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(1) = -5 -> 8. Headline: |score-50| = 8, 50, 17, 33, 17, 42 -> Table (0, 'sacramental'), Worship (8, 'liturgical'), Kingdom (17, 'covenantal'). Distances: Roman Catholic sqrt(169+25+49+4+529+4) = sqrt(780) = 27.9; Anglican (broad) sqrt(4+625+144+9+9+144) = sqrt(935) = 30.6; Eastern Orthodox sqrt(1355) = 36.8; Lutheran sqrt(2230) = 47.2; Wesleyan sqrt(4420) = 66.5; Presbyterian sqrt(5530) = 74.4; Reformed Baptist 109.7; Anabaptist 114.2; Southern Baptist 135.5; Charismatic 138.7; Pentecostal 149.1; Dispensational 158.7. Nearest is Roman Catholic (89% match) with Anglican second (88%). What went wrong: 625 of the Anglican 935 comes from the Table axis, where the tradition is placed at 25 but the three Table statements can only give an Article XXVII/XXVIII Anglican 0-8 (even with S5 = -1, Table = 8 and the margin is Anglican 24.5 vs RC 27.6, a coin flip). Fix A: Anglican (broad) -> [40, 10, 35, 20, 30, 15]: d = sqrt(4+100+4+9+9+49) = sqrt(175) = 13.2, clearly nearest, RC second at 27.9. Fix B (preferred, keeps existing coordinates honest): replace S5 with a statement that splits the sacramental camp (see scoring finding); the same respondent then answers it -1, Table raw -3 -> 25, d(Anglican) = sqrt(310) = 17.6 vs d(RC) = sqrt(1155) = 34.0.

simulations.headline: Sacramental, rooted in tradition, liturgical
simulations.comment: Answers (typical informed Catholic; Thomist-leaning as the seminary default, Trent as the floor): S1 Agree (+1: single predestination, CCC 600; a Molinist would say 0), S2 Strongly agree (+2: Trent VI canon 4, the will 'can dissent'), S3 Agree (+1: faith is a gift, Trent VI ch. 8; Aquinas ST I q.23 a.5 on election before foreseen merit; a Molinist would say -1), S4 +2, S5 -2, S6 +2 (CCC 1250, 1376), S7 +1, S8 -2, S9 +2 (LG 12; CCC 67, 799-801, 2003), S10 -2, S11 +1 (reluctant, see finding), S12 -2 (CCC 676), S13 +2, S14 -2, S15 +2 (DV 10), S16 +2, S17 -2, S18 +2 (LG 11). Raw sums: Grace (-1)(1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(1)=0 -> round(6/12*100)=50. Table (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2)=-6 -> 0. Spirit (-1)(1)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2)=-5 -> round(1/12*100)=8. Kingdom (1)(-2)+(-1)(1)+(1)(-2)=-5 -> 8. Tradition -6 -> 0. Worship -6 -> 0. Headline: |s-50| = 0, 50, 42, 42, 50, 50; top three by distance then index = Table (band 0 'sacramental'), Tradition ('rooted in tradition'), Worship ('liturgical') -> 'Sacramental, rooted in tradition, liturgical'. Distances (squared sums): Eastern Orthodox [65,5,35,15,5,5]: 225+25+729+49+25+25=1078 -> 32.8 (87% match). Roman Catholic [55,5,40,15,10,10]: 25+25+1024+49+100+100=1323 -> 36.4 (85%). Anglican (broad): 3538 -> 59.5. Lutheran: 6643 -> 81.5. Wesleyan: 7783 -> 88.2. Presbyterian: 11413 -> 106.8. Anabaptist: 19043 -> 138.0. Reformed Baptist: 19418 -> 139.3. Charismatic non-denom: 24838 -> 157.6. SBC: 27708 -> 166.5. Pentecostal: 27948 -> 167.2. Dispensational: 36218 -> 190.3. A Catholic answering from the Catechism lands on Eastern Orthodox first. What went wrong: the RC Spirit coordinate of 40 contributes 1024 of the 1323 (the Church officially affirms the charisms and canonizes on verified miracles, so even a cautious Catholic scores 33, never 40+), and RC tradition/worship at 10 versus Orthodox 5 penalize a Catholic who answers those six statements exactly as an Orthodox would. Fix: RC = [55, 5, 20, 15, 5, 5]. Recheck: 25+25+144+49+25+25=293 -> 17.1 vs Orthodox 32.8, RC nearest. Cautious Catholic (spirit 33): RC 25+25+169+49+25+25=318 -> 17.8 vs EO 225+25+4+49+25+25=353 -> 18.8, still RC. Raising EO grace to 75 (Orthodox reject election before foreseen faith more uniformly than Catholics) widens the margin further: EO for the base case 100+25+729+49+25+25=953 -> 30.9.

simulations.lens: charismatic non-denominational (Vineyard, Bethel, Hillsong, Third Wave)
simulations.headline: Continuationist, free in worship, Arminian-leaning
simulations.comment: Answers as a typical informed Third Wave member (Vineyard/Bethel-shaped, not AoG-shaped): Q1 Disagree, Q2 Agree, Q3 Disagree; Q4 Agree (reads 'truly present' as manifest presence), Q5 Strongly agree, Q6 Strongly disagree; Q7/Q9 Strongly agree, Q8 Strongly disagree; Q10 Unsure, Q11 Disagree (pro-Israel reflex), Q12 Disagree (Ladd/Bethel are not pre-trib); Q13 Unsure, Q14 Strongly agree, Q15 Disagree; Q16 Disagree, Q17 Strongly agree, Q18 Disagree. Raw = sum(direction*answer): grace (-1)(-1)+(1)(1)+(-1)(-1)=3 -> round(9/12*100)=75; table (-1)(1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-2)=3 -> 75; spirit (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2)=-6 -> 0; kingdom (1)(0)+(-1)(-1)+(1)(-1)=0 -> 50; tradition (-1)(0)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1)=3 -> 75; worship (-1)(-1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1)=4 -> round(10/12*100)=83. Headline: |score-50| = spirit 50, worship 33, grace/table/tradition tied at 25; the HTML tie-break is axis index, so grace wins -> 'continuationist' + 'free in worship' + 'Arminian-leaning'. Distances (me = 75,75,0,50,75,83): Charismatic non-denom (70,80,5,60,85,90): sqrt(25+25+25+100+100+49)=sqrt(324)=18.0 (93% match); Pentecostal/AoG (80,85,5,75,85,90): sqrt(25+100+25+625+100+49)=sqrt(924)=30.4 (88%); Anabaptist 63.9; Wesleyan 81.5; Southern Baptist 85.4; Reformed Baptist 108.5; Dispensational Bible church 108.9; Anglican 112.4; Presbyterian/Reformed 122.6; Roman Catholic 133.0; Lutheran 135.3; Eastern Orthodox 135.8. Lands correctly, but only because Q10-Q12 pull kingdom to 50: the two charismatic entries sit 18.7 apart (sqrt(100+25+225)), less than a single Strongly-agree-to-Strongly-disagree swing on one statement (33 points on one axis), so the landing is fragile. Three secondary profiles: a Ladd-style Vineyard member (67,75,0,17,58,75) still lands Charismatic but at distance 53.5 (78%) because of the kingdom=60 coordinate; a younger AoG member unsure on Israel and the rapture (75,83,0,58,75,92) lands Charismatic (12.9) ahead of Pentecostal (21.1), i.e. wrong; a Sovereign Grace/Newfrontiers Reformed charismatic (8,83,0,42,75,75) has nothing nearer than 67.3. Fixes and their arithmetic are in the findings.

simulations.headline: Firmly synergist, cessationist, covenantal
simulations.comment: Answers by axis (S1..S18): Grace -2,+2,-2 (no unconditional election; grace resistible, Acts 7:51; faith comes by hearing, Rom 10:17). Table -1,-2,-2 (Supper memorial but 1 Cor 10:16 communion; baptism is NOT an outward sign of a prior decision, it is for the remission of sins, Acts 2:38; no infants). Spirit -2,+2,-2 (1 Cor 13:8-10, Acts 8:18). Kingdom -2,+2,-2 (kingdom established at Pentecost; church is spiritual Israel, Gal 3:29; no rapture). Tradition -2,+2,-2 (no creed but Christ). Worship -2,-1,+2 (no liturgy or calendar; but not 'Spirit-led in the moment', 1 Cor 14:40; weekly Supper, Acts 20:7). Arithmetic: grace raw = (-1)(-2)+(+1)(+2)+(-1)(-2) = 6 -> round(12/12*100) = 100. table raw = (-1)(-1)+(+1)(-2)+(-1)(-2) = 1 -> round(7/12*100) = 58. spirit raw = 6 -> 100. kingdom raw = (+1)(-2)+(-1)(+2)+(+1)(-2) = -6 -> 0. tradition raw = 6 -> 100. worship raw = (-1)(-2)+(+1)(-1)+(-1)(+2) = -1 -> round(5/12*100) = 42. Bands: firmly synergist / centered on the sacraments / cessationist / covenantal / Scripture alone / flexible in worship. Headline: |s-50| = 50,8,50,50,50,8; the four-way tie is broken by axis index, so grace, spirit, kingdom are shown and Tradition (the axis 'no creed but Christ' lives on) is dropped -> 'Firmly synergist, cessationist, covenantal'. Distances (MAXD = sqrt(60000) = 244.9): Anabaptist/Mennonite sqrt(25^2+27^2+45^2+30^2+30^2+18^2) = sqrt(5503) = 74.2 -> 70%; Wesleyan/Methodist sqrt(20^2+18^2+55^2+25^2+55^2+2^2) = sqrt(7403) = 86.0 -> 65%; Southern Baptist sqrt(10288) = 101.4 -> 59%; Reformed Baptist 110.0 (55%); Presbyterian/Reformed 111.9 (54%); Anglican 116.2 (53%); Lutheran 118.7 (52%); Dispensational Bible church 122.2 (50%); Charismatic 128.6 (47%); Roman Catholic 133.3 (46%); Pentecostal/AoG 135.3 (45%); Eastern Orthodox 137.4 (44%). DID NOT LAND: a Church of Christ member is told his two closest church families are pacifist, memorialist, gifts-open Mennonites and paedobaptist Methodists, at 70% and 65%. That is embarrassing and will be screenshotted; the middle of the Table axis (40-70), where believer's-baptism-for-remission lands, is simply empty of traditions. FIX: add 'Churches of Christ / Christian Churches' at grace 90, table 60, spirit 95, kingdom 5, tradition 95, worship 40 (worship 40 reflects where the CURRENT statements 17/18 push actual members; if 17 and 18 are replaced as proposed in the findings, set worship to 85). Check: distance from the simulation to the new entry = sqrt(10^2+2^2+5^2+5^2+5^2+2^2) = sqrt(183) = 13.5 -> 94%, sixty points nearer than anything else. Variant members also land on it: (S4=-2, S11=+1, S17=-2) -> [100,67,100,8,100,33], distance 16.0 (93%); (S17=+1) -> [100,58,100,0,100,58], distance 22.4 (91%); a less-reflective member who agrees with S5 -> [100,92,100,0,100,42], distance 34.7 (86%), still nearest. I also verified the new entry does not hijack anyone: every existing tradition's own coordinates remain nearest to itself; the closest existing entry to the new one is Anabaptist/Mennonite at 64. Note the variant-A run: an a cappella member with no liturgy, no calendar, and extemporaneous prayer receives the worship band 'liturgy-leaning' (score 33), purely because statement 18 counts weekly communion as liturgical and statement 17 counts distrust of spontaneity as liturgical.

simulations.headline: Memorialist, cessationist, dispensational
simulations.comment: Profile: a DTS-trained 'moderate Calvinist' (unconditional election + eternal security, unlimited atonement, hesitant about 'faith is the gift' from the neuter touto in Eph 2:8), memorialist on the ordinances, cessationist, pretrib premillennial with a distinct Israel, non-creedal, in a planned sermon-centred Bible-church service with monthly communion. Ambiguous items: S2 answered Agree (reading 'resist grace' of the unsaved, Acts 7:51, while affirming eternal security); S3 Unsure (affirms election not based on foreseen faith but doubts 'faith itself is a gift'); S17 Disagree ('free-form and led by the Spirit in the moment' is charismatic vocabulary; Bible-church worship is planned). Raw sums (direction x answer): Grace (-1)(1)+(1)(1)+(-1)(0)=0 -> round(6/12*100)=50. Table (-1)(-2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-2)=6 -> 100. Spirit (-1)(-2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-2)=6 -> 100. Kingdom (1)(2)+(-1)(-2)+(1)(2)=6 -> 100. Tradition (-1)(-1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-2)=5 -> round(11/12*100)=round(91.67)=92. Worship (-1)(-1)+(1)(-1)+(-1)(-1)=1 -> round(7/12*100)=round(58.33)=58. Headline: |score-50| = 0,50,50,50,42,8; not all within 10; top three by deviation with index tie-break are Table(1), Spirit(2), Kingdom(3), all score 100 -> bands[4] = memorialist, cessationist, dispensational. Distances (sum of squares -> sqrt): Dispensational Bible church [40,90,90,95,90,75]: 10^2+10^2+10^2+5^2+2^2+17^2 = 100+100+100+25+4+289 = 618 -> 24.86 (match round(100-24.86/244.95*100)=90%). Southern Baptist (typical) [45,85,75,70,85,70]: 25+225+625+900+49+144 = 1968 -> 44.36 (82%). Anabaptist/Mennonite 8263 -> 90.90. Reformed Baptist 9218 -> 96.01. Pentecostal/AG 11848 -> 108.85. Charismatic non-denom 12498 -> 111.79. Wesleyan/Methodist 15683 -> 125.23. Presbyterian/Reformed 16053 -> 126.70. Anglican (broad) 20438 -> 142.96. Lutheran (confessional) 20943 -> 144.72. Roman Catholic 28903 -> 170.01. Eastern Orthodox 31078 -> 176.29. The typical profile lands correctly, but 289 of the 618 squared distance is the Worship axis (coordinate 75 vs. what the statements actually yield, 58). Two real adherent profiles do NOT land: (a) a posttrib/prewrath dispensationalist (Gundry, Rosenthal, Hultberg) who answers S12 = -2: Kingdom raw 2+2-2 = 2 -> 67; vector [50,100,100,67,92,58]; SBC 25+225+625+9+49+144 = 1077 -> 32.82 beats DBC 100+100+100+784+4+289 = 1377 -> 37.11. (b) a progressive dispensationalist 'open but cautious' on the gifts (S7 -1, S8 1, S9 -1 -> Spirit 75; S11 -1, S12 1 -> Kingdom 83): vector [50,100,75,83,92,58]; SBC 25+225+0+169+49+144 = 612 -> 24.74 beats DBC 100+100+225+144+4+289 = 862 -> 29.36. Fixes with arithmetic are in statement:12, statement:17 and tradition:Dispensational Bible church.

simulations.lens: confessional Lutheran (LCMS / WELS / Book of Concord)
simulations.headline: Sacramental, covenantal, liturgical
simulations.comment: Answers (FC SD XI election is certain and in Christ: S1 +2; grace resistible, FC SD II and XI.41: S2 +2; faith a gift and not the cause of election, LCMS Brief Statement 1932: S3 +2; real presence S4 +2; baptism regenerates, SC IV: S5 -2, S6 +2; gifts not the ordinary pattern, SA III.viii: S7 -1, S8 +1, S9 -2; AC XVII amillennial: S10 -2, S11 +1, S12 -2; creeds are norma normata but councils can err: S13 +1; FC Rule and Norm, AC XXVIII: S14 +2; Scripture interprets itself, neither church nor reader is 'final': S15 -1; AC XXIV liturgy kept, every-Sunday Mass: S16 +2, S17 -2, S18 +1). Raw: Grace (-1)(2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(2) = -2 -> round(4/12*100) = 33; Table (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2) = -6 -> 0; Spirit (-1)(-1)+(1)(1)+(-1)(-2) = +4 -> round(83.3) = 83; Kingdom (1)(-2)+(-1)(1)+(1)(-2) = -5 -> round(8.3) = 8; Tradition (-1)(1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1) = +2 -> round(66.7) = 67; Worship (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(1) = -5 -> 8. Headline: |s-50| = Table 50, Kingdom 42, Worship 42, Spirit 33, Grace 17, Tradition 17; top three Table, Kingdom (index tie-break beats Worship), Worship -> bands 'sacramental', 'covenantal', 'liturgical'. Note the Grace band a Lutheran receives is 'Reformed-leaning' (33), which is the one word a confessional Lutheran will screenshot. Distances to Lutheran coords [20,15,70,15,35,20]: sqrt(13^2+15^2+13^2+7^2+32^2+12^2) = sqrt(1780) = 42.2 (83%); Presbyterian [10,35,75,15,45,45]: sqrt(529+1225+64+49+484+1369) = sqrt(3720) = 61.0 (75%); Anglican sqrt(3775) = 61.4; Roman Catholic 75.2; Wesleyan 84.0; Eastern Orthodox 85.2; Reformed Baptist 96.5; Anabaptist 113.9; Southern Baptist 124.3; Dispensational 144.2; Charismatic 153.6; Pentecostal 164.5. So it lands, but only at 83% and only because the competitors are further off; the 32-point miss on Tradition (35 vs 67) is the single largest error and cannot be closed by any honest Lutheran answer set (reaching 35 requires S15 'Agree' or S14 'Unsure', both of which contradict FC Ep Rule and Norm). Fragility check, a plausible LCMS layperson wary of decretal wording and unsure on the gifts (S1 +1, S3 +1, S7 -1, S8 0, S9 -1, S13 +2): scores [50,0,67,8,58,8], Lutheran 43.1 vs Anglican 47.8, a 4.7 margin; with Spirit answered Unsure on all three ([50,0,50,8,67,8]) it flips: Anglican sqrt(2407) = 49.1 beats Lutheran sqrt(2742) = 52.4. Control: an informed Presbyterian (S1 +2, S2 -2, S3 +2, S4 +2, S5 -2, S6 +2, S7 -1, S8 +1, S9 -1, S10 -2, S11 +2, S12 -2, S13 +1, S14 +2, S15 -1, S16 +1, S17 -2, S18 0) scores [0,0,75,0,67,25] and lands on Lutheran (43.9) ahead of Presbyterian (49.3). Proposed fix: Lutheran coords [30,8,75,10,60,15] -> typical Lutheran d = sqrt(9+64+64+4+49+49) = sqrt(239) = 15.5 (94%), wary Lutheran 24.2 (90%); with Presbyterian also recalibrated to [10,10,80,10,60,25] the Presbyterian control returns home (19.3 vs Lutheran 34.8) and the typical Lutheran still lands Lutheran (15.5 vs Presbyterian 31.3), the separator being S2 (resistible grace) and S18 (weekly Supper), which is exactly the historical fault line.

simulations.headline: Sacramental, covenantal, rooted in tradition
simulations.comment: Answers (statements 1-18): -2,+2,-1 | +2,-2,+2 | +1,-2,+1 | -2,+2,-2 | +2,-2,+2 | +2,-2,+2. Raw = sum(direction x answer): Grace (-1)(-2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1)=5 -> round(11/12x100)=92; Table (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2)=-6 -> 0; Spirit (-1)(1)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(1)=-4 -> round(2/12x100)=17; Kingdom (1)(-2)+(-1)(2)+(1)(-2)=-6 -> 0; Tradition (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2)=-6 -> 0; Worship (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2)=-6 -> 0. Headline: |score-50| = 42,50,33,50,50,50; four axes tie at 50 and the code breaks ties by axis index, so Table (band 0 'sacramental'), Kingdom ('covenantal'), Tradition ('rooted in tradition') -> 'Sacramental, covenantal, rooted in tradition'; 'liturgical' and 'firmly synergist' never appear. Distances (sum of squares -> sqrt -> match%): Eastern Orthodox 729+25+324+225+25+25=1353 -> 36.78 -> 85%; Roman Catholic 1369+25+529+225+100+100=2348 -> 48.46 -> 80%; Anglican 5813 -> 76.24 -> 69%; Wesleyan 6778 -> 82.33 -> 66%; Lutheran 10068 -> 100.34; Presbyterian 15588 -> 124.85; Anabaptist 18358 -> 135.49; Reformed Baptist 23743 -> 154.09; Charismatic 25953 -> 161.10; Pentecostal 28463 -> 168.71; Southern Baptist 29823 -> 172.69; Dispensational 38883 -> 197.19. So it lands, but 729 of the 1353 comes from the Grace coordinate (65 vs my 92), and the margin is fragile. Sensitivity: an equally defensible Orthodox pattern (S1 Unsure, since predestination-according-to-foreknowledge is eternal; S2 Agree; S3 Agree, since faith is a gift; S7/S9/S12 Unsure) gives [50,0,33,17,0,0] and lands ROMAN CATHOLIC first: RC 25+25+49+4+100+100=303 -> 17.41 (93%), EO 225+25+4+4+25+25=308 -> 17.55 (93%). Moving the EO coordinate alone does not rescue that case (EO grace 85 makes it 1368 -> 36.99). Rewriting statements 1 and 3 as proposed (an Orthodox then answers -2 to both) turns that pattern into [92,0,33,17,0,0]: EO 812 -> 28.50 vs RC 1647 -> 40.58 with current coordinates; with EO moved to grace 85 / spirit 25, EO 192 -> 13.86 (94%) vs RC 40.58. My main pattern against the proposed EO coordinates: 4+25+64+225+25+25=413 -> 20.32 (92%).

simulations.lens: Pentecostal (Assemblies of God Statement of Fundamental Truths)
simulations.headline: Continuationist, firmly synergist, memorialist
simulations.comment: Answers S1..S18 as an informed AG member: -2,2,-1 | -1,2,-2 | 2,-2,2 | 1,-1,2 | -1,2,-1 | -2,2,-1. Raw: grace (-1)(-2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1)=5 -> round(11/12*100)=92; table (-1)(-1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-2)=5 -> 92; spirit (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2)=-6 -> 0; kingdom (1)(1)+(-1)(-1)+(1)(2)=4 -> round(10/12*100)=83; tradition (-1)(-1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1)=4 -> 83; worship (-1)(-2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1)=5 -> 92. |score-50|: spirit 50, grace 42, table 42, worship 42, kingdom 33, tradition 33; sort by distance then index gives spirit, grace, table -> bands 'continuationist', 'firmly synergist', 'memorialist' -> 'Continuationist, firmly synergist, memorialist'. Per-axis bands: kingdom 83 = 'dispensational', tradition 83 = 'Scripture alone', worship 92 = 'free in worship'. Distances (squares summed): Pentecostal/AoG 144+49+25+64+4+4=290 -> 17.03 (93%); Charismatic non-denom 484+144+25+529+4+4=1190 -> 34.50 (86%); Anabaptist 85.82; Southern Baptist 92.41; Dispensational Bible church 106.25; Wesleyan 111.29; Reformed Baptist 133.90; Anglican 145.53; Presbyterian 154.52; Roman Catholic 164.97; Eastern Orthodox 166.73; Lutheran 167.71. Lands correctly. Sensitivity: (a) an AG member who reads S1 as foreknowledge and agrees (+1) with S3 unsure gets grace 58 ('balanced on grace') yet still lands AoG (25.10 vs 29.15); (b) an AG member agnostic on the pretrib rapture (S10=0, S11=-1, S12=-1) gets kingdom 50 and flips to Charismatic non-denom 27.59 vs AoG 29.17 -- the nearest-tradition call between the two Pentecostal-type entries is decided entirely by eschatology and election because both sit at spirit=5 and the axis has no statement on Spirit baptism or initial evidence; (c) S4 answered +1 from experience of Christ's presence at the Table gives table 75 but still AoG nearest (18.47).

simulations.lens: Presbyterian / Reformed (Westminster Standards, Three Forms of Unity)
simulations.headline: Firmly monergist, covenantal, sacramental
simulations.comment: Persona: confessional Presbyterian, spiritual presence (WCF 29.7), paedobaptist, cessationist (WCF 1.1, 1.6), amillennial, regulative principle, fixed order of worship but no prayer book, monthly communion. Raw sums (direction x answer): Grace (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2) = -6 -> round(0/12*100) = 0. Table (-1)(1)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2) = -5 -> round(1/12*100) = 8. Spirit (-1)(-2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1) = 5 -> round(11/12*100) = 92. Kingdom (1)(-2)+(-1)(2)+(1)(-2) = -6 -> 0. Tradition (-1)(1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1) = 2 -> round(8/12*100) = 67. Worship (-1)(0)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(-1) = -1 -> round(5/12*100) = 42. Headline: |score-50| = 50, 42, 42, 50, 17, 8; top three with index tie-break = grace (firmly monergist), kingdom (covenantal), table (sacramental, index 1 beats spirit index 2 on the tie). Distances: Presbyterian/Reformed sqrt(100+729+289+225+484+9) = sqrt(1836) = 42.85 (83%); Lutheran sqrt(400+49+484+225+1024+484) = sqrt(2666) = 51.63 (79%); Reformed Baptist 75.24; Anglican 79.69; Roman Catholic 101.17; Wesleyan 103.66; Eastern Orthodox 113.67; Anabaptist 118.98; Southern Baptist 119.38; Dispensational 137.74; Charismatic 154.53; Pentecostal 167.78. So this persona lands, but only 83% on its own tradition, and 729 of the 1836 squared distance comes from the Table coordinate (35) sitting 27 points from where honest Reformed answers put a person (0-17). A second, equally typical persona FAILS: a Three Forms of Unity member (URCNA/CRC/RCUS/Canadian Reformed) who answers S4 +2 (Belgic 35: Christ truly gives himself, not a bare sign), S13 +2 (Belgic 9 receives the three creeds), S14 +1, S16 +1 (the Church Order's set liturgical forms for baptism and the Supper), S18 0, everything else as above, scores [0, 0, 92, 0, 50, 25] and gets Lutheran (confessional) at sqrt(400+225+484+225+225+25) = 39.80 ahead of Presbyterian/Reformed at sqrt(100+1225+289+225+25+400) = 47.58. Fix: set the Presbyterian/Reformed table coordinate to 15 (the statements cannot separate bodily from spiritual presence, so the coordinate should not pretend they do). With table=15 alone: Continental persona -> P/R sqrt(1264) = 35.55 beats Lutheran 39.80; main persona -> P/R sqrt(1156) = 34.00 (86%). With table=15, spirit=85, tradition=60: main persona -> P/R sqrt(100+49+49+225+49+9) = 21.93 (91%); Continental -> 33.15 vs Lutheran 39.80; Hodge-style persona [0,17,100,8,42,50] -> 26.96 vs 47.98. Self-check: with the new coordinates every tradition's own coordinate point still maps to itself (nearest other: Lutheran at 39.7).

simulations.lens: progressive mainline Protestant (PCUSA, ELCA, Episcopal, UMC progressive wing)
simulations.headline: Sacramental, liturgy-leaning, open to the gifts
simulations.comment: Persona: an informed progressive PCUSA/ELCA-type pastor (Barth- and Luther-literate on election, sacramental, not cessationist but not charismatic, amillennial, creedal, service-book worship with communion weekly-to-monthly). Answers in order: S1 0 (Barthian: cannot affirm 'chosen who' particularism, will not deny 'cannot fail'), S2 +1, S3 +1, S4 +2, S5 -2, S6 +2, S7 0 (healing rites yes, 'tongues as in Acts' no), S8 -1, S9 +1, S10 -2, S11 -2 (supersessionism is formally repudiated by PCUSA 1987, ELCA 1994, UMC 1996, TEC 1988), S12 -2, S13 +1, S14 -1, S15 0, S16 +1, S17 -1, S18 +1. Raw: grace (-1*0)+(1*1)+(-1*1)=0 -> 50; table (-1*2)+(1*-2)+(-1*2)=-6 -> 0; spirit (-1*0)+(1*-1)+(-1*1)=-2 -> round(4/12*100)=33; kingdom (1*-2)+(-1*-2)+(1*-2)=-2 -> 33; tradition (-1*1)+(1*-1)+(-1*0)=-2 -> 33; worship (-1*1)+(1*-1)+(-1*1)=-3 -> 25. Headline: |s-50| = 0,50,17,17,17,25 -> table (band 0 'sacramental'), worship (25, band 1 'liturgy-leaning'), then a three-way tie at 17 broken by index to spirit (33, band 1 'open to the gifts'). Distances from (50,0,33,33,33,25): Anglican (broad) sqrt(100+625+144+169+9+25)=sqrt(1072)=32.7 (87%); Roman Catholic sqrt(25+25+49+324+529+225)=sqrt(1177)=34.3 (86%); Eastern Orthodox sqrt(1762)=42.0 (83%); Lutheran (confessional) sqrt(2847)=53.4 (78%); Wesleyan / Methodist sqrt(3077)=55.5 (77%); Presbyterian / Reformed sqrt(1600+1225+1764+324+144+400)=sqrt(5457)=73.9 (70%); Reformed Baptist 103.9; Anabaptist 104.6; Southern Baptist 122.9; Charismatic 123.5; Pentecostal 132.7; Dispensational Bible church 145.1. VERDICT: for an Episcopalian this is right (Anglican first). For a PCUSA Presbyterian it is a screenshot: 'Presbyterian / Reformed' ranks 6th of 12, behind Eastern Orthodox and Wesleyan, because that entry is coded as a PCA/OPC profile (grace 10, spirit 75 cessationist). ELCA variant (S1 +1, S13 +2, S16 +2, S17 -2 -> scores 42,0,33,33,25,8): Roman Catholic sqrt(796)=28.2 first, Anglican 33.3, Orthodox 35.9, Lutheran (confessional) sqrt(2646)=51.4 fourth, driven by that entry's spirit 70 (37^2=1369 of the 2646). A Lutheran pastor landing on Rome is the headline screenshot. Two causes: (a) S11 is worded as replacement theology, costing 33 points on Kingdom; (b) there is no mainline entry. Fixing S11 alone makes it WORSE: with kingdom 0 the PCUSA persona (50,0,33,0,33,25) is nearest Roman Catholic sqrt(1078)=32.8, then Anglican 36.1. FIX: add 'Mainline Protestant (PCUSA / ELCA / UMC)' at grace 45, table 10, spirit 35, kingdom 10, tradition 30, worship 20. Check with S11 fixed: PCUSA persona -> sqrt(25+100+4+100+9+25)=sqrt(263)=16.2 (93%), beating RC 32.8 and Anglican 36.1; ELCA persona (42,0,33,0,25,8) -> sqrt(9+100+4+100+25+144)=sqrt(382)=19.5, beating RC sqrt(697)=26.4; UMC progressive (grace 92, table 8, spirit 33, kingdom 0, tradition 33, worship 25) -> Wesleyan sqrt(2306)=48.0 vs Mainline sqrt(2351)=48.5, both correct as the top two. The new entry does not steal existing prototypes: the Anglican (broad) prototype is 21.2 from it and the Roman Catholic prototype 26.0, each still at distance 0 from its own entry. Even with the current unfixed S11, the PCUSA persona is sqrt(25+100+4+529+9+25)=sqrt(692)=26.3 from the new entry, which already beats Anglican 32.7.

simulations.headline: Firmly monergist, cessationist, covenantal
simulations.comment: Answers as a typical informed 1689 subscriber. Grace: (-1)(+2)+(+1)(-2)+(-1)(+2) = -6 -> round(0/12*100) = 0, 'firmly monergist'. Table: (-1)(+1)+(+1)(+1)+(-1)(-2) = +2 -> round(8/12*100) = 67, 'memorial-leaning' (statement 4 answered Agree per LBC 30.7 'really and indeed... spiritually receive and feed upon Christ'; statement 5 answered Agree with a grimace at 'decision'). Spirit: (-1)(-2)+(+1)(+2)+(-1)(-2) = +6 -> 100, 'cessationist'. Kingdom: (+1)(-2)+(-1)(+1)+(+1)(-2) = -5 -> round(1/12*100) = 8, 'covenantal'. Tradition: (-1)(+1)+(+1)(+2)+(-1)(-1) = +2 -> 67, 'Scripture-first'. Worship: (-1)(-1)+(+1)(-2)+(-1)(-1) = 0 -> 50, 'flexible in worship'. Headline: |s-50| = 50,17,50,42,17,0; top three by distance with index tie-break = grace(0), spirit(100), kingdom(8) -> 'Firmly monergist, cessationist, covenantal' (acceptable to us). Distances (squared sums): Reformed Baptist 100+9+400+484+144+225 = 1362 -> 36.91 (85% match); Presbyterian / Reformed 100+1024+625+49+484+25 = 2307 -> 48.03 (80%); Lutheran 77.31; Southern Baptist 86.84; Anabaptist 92.56; Anglican 93.82; Dispensational 104.65; Wesleyan 105.01; Roman Catholic 123.96; Eastern Orthodox 134.95; Charismatic 136.83; Pentecostal 148.87. So the typical pattern lands correctly, but the margin is thin and fragile: the largest contributors to the RB distance are the RB entry's own coordinates on Kingdom (30 vs my 8: 484) and Worship (65 vs my 50: 225) and Spirit (80 vs 100: 400), not my answers. A confession-literal RB who answers Strongly agree to statement 4 (30.7 says 'really and indeed') and Disagree to statement 5 (because baptism is a sign of union with Christ, LBC 29.1, not of 'a decision') gets Table = (-1)(+2)+(+1)(-1)+(-1)(-2) = -1 -> 42, and then lands Presbyterian / Reformed (36.50) ahead of Reformed Baptist (46.23). That is a real adherent landing on the wrong tradition. With the proposed RB coordinates [10,65,90,15,60,50] and Presbyterian table 20, the main pattern gives RB 17.38 (93%) vs Presbyterian 59.09, and the confession-literal pattern gives RB 28.76 vs Presbyterian 42.04, so both land correctly.

simulations.lens: Reformed charismatic (John Piper, Wayne Grudem, Sam Storms, Sovereign Grace Churches, Acts 29 continuationists)
simulations.headline: Firmly monergist, continuationist, covenantal
simulations.comment: Answers as a typical Sovereign Grace / Bethlehem / Acts 29 continuationist: S1 +2, S2 -2 (reading 'God's grace' as effectual grace, see finding on statement 2), S3 +2; S4 +1 (Calvin's spiritual presence, Grudem ST ch. 50), S5 +1, S6 -2; S7 +2, S8 -2, S9 +2; S10 -1, S11 +1, S12 -2; S13 +1 (creeds have real but subordinate authority), S14 +2, S15 -1; S16 -1, S17 0 (planned AND Spirit-led, so the double-barrel forces Unsure), S18 -1. Raw sums (direction x answer): Grace (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2) = -6 -> round(0/12*100) = 0. Table (-1)(1)+(1)(1)+(-1)(-2) = +2 -> round(8/12*100) = 67. Spirit (-1)(2)+(1)(-2)+(-1)(2) = -6 -> 0. Kingdom (1)(-1)+(-1)(1)+(1)(-2) = -4 -> round(2/12*100) = 17. Tradition (-1)(1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1) = +2 -> 67. Worship (-1)(-1)+(1)(0)+(-1)(-1) = +2 -> 67. Headline: |score-50| = 50, 17, 50, 33, 17, 17, so grace (band 0 'firmly monergist'), spirit (band 0 'continuationist'), kingdom (17, band 0 'covenantal'): 'Firmly monergist, continuationist, covenantal' -- this label is accurate and a member would happily share it. Distances (sum of squared diffs -> d -> match = round(100 - d/244.95*100)): Reformed Baptist 100+9+6400+169+144+4 = 6826 -> 82.6 -> 66%; Presbyterian / Reformed 100+1024+5625+4+484+484 = 7721 -> 87.9 -> 64%; Charismatic non-denominational 4900+169+25+1849+324+529 = 7796 -> 88.3 -> 64%; Anglican (broad) 8976 -> 94.7; Anabaptist / Mennonite 9201 -> 95.9; Wesleyan / Methodist 10431 -> 102.1; Pentecostal / AoG 10966 -> 104.7; Southern Baptist 11116 -> 105.4; Lutheran 11241 -> 106.0; Roman Catholic 14971 -> 122.4; Dispensational Bible church 16906 -> 130.0; Eastern Orthodox 16986 -> 130.3. What went wrong: the nearest entry differs from me by 80 points on Spirit (the largest gap the axis allows) and the runner-up by 75; the share card tells a Sovereign Grace member 'Closest: Reformed Baptist · Presbyterian / Reformed', two cessationist families, with a 66% ceiling that is the lowest any real movement gets from this list. Second place is a coin flip: Presbyterian beats Charismatic non-denominational by 0.4 of a distance unit, and changing S17 from Unsure to Agree (worship 67 -> 75) reorders to Reformed Baptist 83.2, Charismatic non-denominational 86.6, Presbyterian 90.2. Fix: add 'Reformed charismatic' at {grace 10, table 65, spirit 10, kingdom 20, tradition 60, worship 70}: distance from my scores 100+4+100+9+49+9 = 271 -> 16.5 -> 93%. It does not poach neighbours: the Reformed Baptist coordinate is 71.2 from it (0 from itself), Presbyterian 77.5, Charismatic non-denominational 80.5, Pentecostal 96.8.

simulations.headline: Memorialist, Scripture alone, firmly synergist
simulations.comment: Profile simulated: the modal SBC member, a non-Calvinist ('Traditionalist') who holds eternal security, memorial ordinances, open-but-cautious cessationism, pew-level pretrib premillennialism, sola Scriptura, and a planned but non-liturgical service. Raw sums (direction x answer): Grace (-1)(-1)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-1)=4 -> round(10/12*100)=83; Table (-1)(-2)+(1)(2)+(-1)(-2)=6 -> 100; Spirit 1+1+1=3 -> 75; Kingdom 1+1+1=3 -> 75; Tradition 1+2+2=5 -> round(91.67)=92; Worship 1+0+1=2 -> round(66.67)=67. Headline: |s-50| = 33,50,25,25,42,17 -> Table(100 'memorialist'), Tradition(92 'Scripture alone'), Grace(83 'firmly synergist'). Squared distances to every tradition: Southern Baptist 38^2+15^2+0+5^2+7^2+3^2=1752 -> 41.86 (match 83%); Dispensational Bible church 43^2+10^2+15^2+20^2+2^2+8^2=2642 -> 51.40 (79%); Anabaptist 3247 -> 56.98; Pentecostal 5712 -> 75.58; Charismatic 6272 -> 79.20; Reformed Baptist 9652 -> 98.24; Wesleyan 9947 -> 99.73; Presbyterian 15847 -> 125.88; Anglican 17452 -> 132.11; Lutheran 20277 -> 142.40; Roman Catholic 24607 -> 156.87; Eastern Orthodox 25962 -> 161.13. So this profile lands correctly, but note that 1444 of the 1752 squared distance comes from the Grace axis alone, because the SBC coordinate (45) is an average of two populations that no actual member occupies. TWO VARIANTS THAT MATTER: (a) Historic premillennial Traditionalist (Ladd-type, the dominant view among SBC seminary faculty; BF&M X is deliberately silent on the millennium): S10=+1, S11=-1, S12=-2 -> Kingdom raw 0 -> 50. Scores [83,100,75,50,92,67]. Anabaptist/Mennonite: 8^2+15^2+20^2+20^2+22^2+7^2=1622 -> 40.27; Southern Baptist: 38^2+15^2+0+20^2+7^2+3^2=2127 -> 46.12. A real Southern Baptist lands on 'Anabaptist / Mennonite' first. That is a blocker. With the proposed non-Calvinist SBC entry at grace 75 the same answers give 8^2+15^2+0+20^2+7^2+3^2=747 -> 27.33, comfortably first. (b) Calvinist Southern Baptist (about 30% of SBC pastors per Lifeway 2012): S1=+2, S2=-2, S3=+2 -> Grace 0; scores [0,100,75,75,92,67]. Southern Baptist 45^2+15^2+0+5^2+7^2+3^2=2333 -> 48.30; Dispensational Bible church 2393 -> 48.92; Reformed Baptist 4423 -> 66.51. Lands on SBC by 0.6 points of distance, i.e. by luck. With a split entry 'Southern Baptist (Calvinist)' at [15,85,75,55,85,70]: 15^2+15^2+0+20^2+7^2+3^2=908 -> 30.13, clearly first, and the two SBC entries do not crowd each other out (the non-Calvinist entry is 77 away from this profile and the Calvinist entry is 73 away from the Traditionalist profile).

simulations.lens: Wesleyan / Methodist (Wesley's sermons, Articles of Religion, Global Methodist / UMC evangelical wing)
simulations.headline: Firmly synergist, sacramental, covenantal
simulations.comment: Answers (statement: answer -> direction*answer). Grace: S1 -2 -> +2 (Wesley, 'Free Grace', rejects unconditional election); S2 +2 -> +2 (resistible grace); S3 -1 -> +1 (I affirm faith is God's gift but deny 'to those he has chosen', so I can only Disagree). raw +5, score round(11/12*100)=92, band 'firmly synergist'. Table: S4 +2 -> -2 (Art. XVIII, spiritual real presence); S5 -1 -> -1 (Art. XVII: 'not only a sign of profession'); S6 +2 -> -2 (Art. XVII: infant baptism 'to be retained'). raw -5, score round(1/12*100)=8, 'sacramental'. Spirit: S7 +1 -> -1; S8 -1 -> -1; S9 +1 -> -1 (Wesley to Middleton 1749; 'The More Excellent Way'). raw -3, score 25, 'open to the gifts'. Kingdom: S10 -1 -> -1; S11 +1 -> -1; S12 -2 -> -2. raw -4, score round(2/12*100)=17, 'covenantal'. Tradition: S13 +1 -> -1; S14 +1 -> +1 (Art. V); S15 -1 -> +1. raw +1, score round(7/12*100)=58, 'balanced on authority'. Worship: S16 +1 -> -1; S17 -1 -> -1; S18 +1 -> -1 ('Duty of Constant Communion'). raw -3, score 25, 'liturgy-leaning'. Headline: |score-50| = 42, 42, 25, 33, 8, 25; top three = grace (idx 0, tie broken by index), table, kingdom -> 'Firmly synergist, sacramental, covenantal'. Distances (squared sums): Wesleyan/Methodist (80,40,45,25,45,40): 144+1024+400+64+169+225 = 2026 -> 45.0 (82% match). Eastern Orthodox: 729+9+100+4+2809+400 = 4051 -> 63.6. Roman Catholic: 1369+9+225+4+2304+225 = 4136 -> 64.3. Anglican (broad): 2704+289+400+9+784+25 = 4211 -> 64.9. Lutheran 88.4, Anabaptist 93.0, Presbyterian 102.6, Charismatic 113.5, Pentecostal 121.6, Reformed Baptist 124.0, SBC 127.3, Dispensational 152.5. Lands correctly, but note (a) the 45-point gap to my own tradition is almost entirely the table coordinate (32 of it) plus spirit and worship: the entry is set at 40/45/40 where Wesley and the Articles put us near 10-25/35/25; with the proposed coordinates (85,25,35,25,45,35) the distance falls to 27.8 (89%), and a 'pew' Methodist (answers -2,2,0,1,0,2,0,-1,1,-1,1,-1,1,1,0,1,-1,0 -> 83,25,33,25,50,33) goes from 21.3 to 6.1; (b) second-nearest is Eastern Orthodox rather than Anglican, which an informed Methodist would find odd since Methodism is an Anglican offshoot, driven by Anglican (broad) being set at grace 40; (c) a Methodist who answers S3 'Agree' because faith is God's gift drops to grace 75 and the headline changes to 'Sacramental, covenantal, Arminian-leaning' (see statement:3).
